text: そう　かんたんには　いかないぜ！

structure.jp: そう　かんたんには

patterns.name: そう〜ない
patterns.span: そう　かんたんには　いかない
patterns.explanation: そう together with a 'not' ending means 'not that much' or 'not so...'. そう　かんたんには　いかない = 'it won't go that easily'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, cocky men's speech that pushes the point at the listener. いかないぜ = 'it won't go, I tell you'.
